queries.result: First-party discovery found the official Florencia municipal electronic office, an IGAC notice confirming Florencia as the habilitated local cadastral manager, the DATACAQUETÁ official catalog linking a local cadastral geovisor, and an IGAC ArcGIS service for Florencia base cartography. No safe public parcel-vector response was verified.

queries.result: La búsqueda oficial confirmó a la Alcaldía de Florencia como gestor catastral habilitado, el geovisor catastral local enlazado por DATACAQUETÁ y la cartografía base IGAC de Florencia. No se verificó una respuesta pública anónima con identificador predial seguro y geometría poligonal completa.

registryCustodian: Alcaldía de Florencia (Caquetá) is evidenced by the IGAC first-party notice as the habilitated municipal cadastral manager from 2022; IGAC remains the national cadastral authority and serves the other Caquetá municipalities.

registryEvidence.interpretation: A local cadastral custodian and a public geovisor route are evidenced. This does not establish an open parcel geometry API or citywide machine-readable coverage.
